headline: Quantum Keys, State Structure, and 2D Emitters
summary: Today's selection bridges theoretical quantum information and solid-state photonic implementations. Contributions span mathematical diagnostics of multipartite entanglement, experimental cryptographic protocols using multi-qubit photons, and defect modeling for single-photon emitters in 2D materials.

themes.title: Quantum Information & Cryptography
themes.body: Papers explore both foundational entanglement theory via edge-colored graph invariants and practical quantum key generation using hyper-entangled two-photon states.

themes.title: Solid-State Quantum Photonics
themes.body: First-principles modeling reveals how substrate interactions in MoS2/hBN heterostructures sharpen single-photon emission from defect states.

connections.body: Both papers address high-dimensional quantum states: one establishes mathematical bounds on multipartite entanglement, while the other experimentally harnesses a six-qubit state across photon paths and polarizations.
